say:1:1041581001:1.text: Hey there, friend! Are those armguards on your arms? Where'd you leave your gauntlets?
say:1:1041581001:1.source_cn: 嘿，那位蛮血朋友！你手臂上的是护腕吗？你的拳套去哪了？

say:3:1041581003:1.text: As for these... you mean two plates of scale armor? I suppose you could call them armguards.
say:3:1041581003:1.source_cn: 至于手臂上的……你说的是这两块鳞甲吧？说是护腕应该也没...

say:4:1041581004:1.text: Oh! My mistake! I saw that build and thought you were a brawling wrestler like me!
say:4:1041581004:1.source_cn: 噢！抱歉抱歉，我还以为你也和我一样，是个擅长用拳的摔角手呢。

say:5:1041581005:1.text: Really? I look like a wrestler to you?
say:5:1041581005:1.source_cn: 是吗？原来我看起来很像摔角手啊！

say:6:1041581006:1.text: Alsa: Shame my martial skills aren't anything special. If it weren't for these tough scales, I probably wouldn't have survived the desert, let alone led the Uru Clan through its troubles.
say:6:1041581006:1.source_cn: 可惜我的武技其实不算很出众。要不是有这身还算坚硬的鳞甲...

say:7:1041581007:1.text: If you're looking for a wrestling partner, I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint you!
say:7:1041581007:1.source_cn: 如果你是在找摔角对手的话，可能要让你失望了，抱歉啦。

say:9:1041581009:1.text: You're young, you're tough, and you've got incredible natural talent! How could you possibly doubt yourself?
say:9:1041581009:1.source_cn: 像你这么年轻又坚毅的孩子，还与生俱来这么出众的天赋，怎...

say:10:1041581010:1.text: I've never set foot in the desert, but I know how brutal it is. You've already proven your strength!
say:10:1041581010:1.source_cn: 我虽然没有去过沙漠，但也听说过生活在那种环境下有多艰苦...

say:11:1041581011:1.text: "A diamond in the rough still shines"! You're just a gem buried beneath all that desert sand!
say:11:1041581011:1.source_cn: “是金子总会发光”！你只是恰巧生在沙漠里，被漫天的沙子...

say:12:1041581012:1.text: Ahem... Thanks for saying that. People rarely praise me like that.
say:12:1041581012:1.source_cn: 咳咳……谢谢你的夸奖……很少有人这么夸奖我呢。

say:13:1041581013:1.text: Maybe you're right. Perhaps I should leave the desert and see the world—though, uh, I'll need to get everything in order with the Uru Clan first.
say:13:1041581013:1.source_cn: 也许你说得对，我该离开沙漠外出旅行一趟——呃，不过要先...

say:14:1041581014:1.text: When I do, maybe I'll head over to Wilder lands!
say:14:1041581014:1.source_cn: 到时候，我可以去绿裔的领地上看看！

say:15:1041581015:1.text: Then it's a promise! I'll be there to welcome you!
say:15:1041581015:1.source_cn: 哈哈，那就一言为定！我会去迎接你的！

say:16:1041581016:1.text: And if you happen to discover a hidden talent for wrestling along the way, don't forget to challenge me to a proper match!
say:16:1041581016:1.source_cn: 要是到时你发现了自己的摔角天赋，千万别忘了和我痛快地比...
